unresolved_items: Novelty of all 100 candidates is unverified (every candidate labeled HYPOTHESIS or MODEL SPECULATION per evidence_policy.forbid_fiction); a later verifier/consolidator must check each against real prior work before acceptance.

No deduplication was performed against sibling shards (genA-01 SAM/PEFT, genA-02 medical-seg, genA-03 smoke-fire-ambiguous) or later territories; cross-shard overlap is possible in evaluation-protocol, uncertainty/calibration, label-noise, and synthetic-data clusters.
Candidates assuming multi-annotator subsets, RAW-image detection data, geotagged evaluation splits, or source-video provenance presume such data can be sourced; feasibility was not checked.

Four candidates (dete-0019, dete-0049, dete-0056, dete-0072) are labeled MODEL SPECULATION because their premises hinge on unmeasured field-wide statistical or confounding claims; they need especially careful downstream vetting.
note: Novelty unverified for all candidates.
